faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Indore Post-Doctoral Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIM Indore Post-Doctoral Fellow positions is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have successfully defended their Ph.D. within 5 years from a premier institute and have a minimum of 60% marks or 1st division in their master's degree.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any publication requirement for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, a desirable qualification is a minimum of a B category publication (or above) in ABDC or equivalent journal lists.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email with all required documents attached. Specific email addresses will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The position is contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q8. Which department is recruiting for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Operations Management & Quantitative Techniques domain at IIM Indore.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Indore located?
faq.answer: IIM Indore is located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 453556.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position will primarily involve an interview.
